name: Aadhaar number (existing Aadhaar)
description: The Aadhaar number of the person whose Aadhaar is being updated.

name: Mobile number registered with Aadhaar
description: Needed to receive the OTP for online Aadhaar update.

name: Existing Voter ID (EPIC) number
description: EPIC number of an elector already enrolled in the electoral roll.

name: Existing driving licence
description: The driving licence whose address is being changed.

name: Certificate of registration (RC) of the vehicle
description: The vehicle's current registration certificate.

name: Old passport (original)
description: The currently held passport, submitted in original with self-attested copies of its first two and last two pages.

name: Aadhaar card/letter showing current address
description: Aadhaar letter, card or e-Aadhaar that already shows the new address.

name: Voter ID (EPIC) showing current address
name_hi: वर्तमान पते वाला मतदाता पहचान पत्र (EPIC)
description: Voter ID card / e-EPIC issued for the new address.

name: Electoral roll entry at current address
name_hi: वर्तमान पते पर मतदाता सूची में प्रविष्टि
description: Your entry in the electoral roll at the new address.

name: Indian passport showing current address
description: A valid Indian passport whose address is the new address.

name: Driving licence showing current address
description: Driving licence with the new address printed on it.

name: RC showing current address
description: Certificate of registration with the new address recorded.

name: Electricity bill for current address
description: Electricity bill for the new address. Age limits differ by service (see requirement notes).

name: Water bill for current address
name_hi: वर्तमान पते का पानी का बिल
description: Water bill for the new address. Age limits differ by service.

name: Gas connection bill for current address
name_hi: वर्तमान पते का गैस कनेक्शन बिल
description: Gas bill for the new address. Age limits differ by service.

name: Telephone landline / postpaid mobile / broadband bill
name_hi: टेलीफ़ोन लैंडलाइन / पोस्टपेड मोबाइल / ब्रॉडबैंड बिल
description: Phone or broadband bill for the new address.

name: Bank or Post Office passbook (current address)
description: Passbook showing the new address. Each service has its own conditions (photo, bank type, stamp).

name: Bank / credit card / Post Office account statement
name_hi: बैंक / क्रेडिट कार्ड / डाकघर खाता विवरण
description: Statement with bank stamp and signature, showing the new address.

name: Ration / PDS photo card / e-Ration card
name_hi: राशन / पीडीएस फ़ोटो कार्ड / ई-राशन कार्ड
description: Ration card showing the new address.

name: Property tax receipt
description: Property tax receipt for the new address.

name: Rent / lease agreement
description: Rent, lease or leave-and-licence agreement for the new address. Some services require it to be registered.

name: Registered sale deed / sale agreement
description: Sale deed or sale agreement registered with the Registrar for the new address.

name: Revenue Department land-owning records (incl. Kisan Bahi)
name_hi: राजस्व विभाग के भू-स्वामित्व अभिलेख (किसान बही सहित)
description: Land records from the Revenue Department.

name: Life insurance policy
description: Insurance policy document showing the new address.

name: Certificate of address on UIDAI standard format
name_hi: UIDAI मानक प्रारूप में पते का प्रमाणपत्र
description: Certificate on the UIDAI standard format issued by an authorised signatory (e.g. MP/MLA, gazetted officer, Tehsildar, village panchayat head).

name: Income Tax assessment order
description: Income Tax assessment order showing the new address.

name: Certificate from employer on letterhead
name_hi: नियोक्ता द्वारा लेटरहेड पर जारी प्रमाणपत्र
description: Address certificate on company letterhead with seal (public limited companies only, per Passport Seva).

name: Spouse's passport (copy)
description: Spouse's passport naming the applicant as spouse, where the address matches the applicant's present address.

name: Proof of new address accepted by the Registering Authority
name_hi: पंजीकरण प्राधिकरण द्वारा मान्य नए पते का प्रमाण
description: Parivahan does not list specific documents for RC address change; use a proof of address accepted by your State Transport Department / RTO.

name: Valid vehicle insurance certificate
description: Current motor insurance certificate for the vehicle.

name: Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate
description: Valid PUC certificate for the vehicle.

name: No Objection Certificate from financier
description: NOC from the bank/financier when the vehicle is hypothecated.

name: PAN card copy or Form 60 / Form 61
name_hi: पैन कार्ड की प्रति या फ़ॉर्म 60 / फ़ॉर्म 61
description: Attested copy of PAN card, or Form 60/61 as applicable.

name: Pencil print of chassis and engine number
name_hi: चेसिस और इंजन नंबर की पेंसिल प्रिंट
description: Pencil impression of the vehicle's chassis and engine numbers.

name: Passport-size photograph
description: Recent passport-size photograph.

name: Marriage certificate (issued by government / Registrar of Marriage)
name_hi: विवाह प्रमाणपत्र (सरकार / विवाह रजिस्ट्रार द्वारा जारी)
description: Marriage registration certificate issued by a Central/State Government authority.

name: Gazette notification of name change
description: Official Gazette notification publishing a change of name.

name: Joint photo declaration of husband and wife (Passport Annexure J)
name_hi: पति-पत्नी की संयुक्त फ़ोटो घोषणा (पासपोर्ट अनुलग्नक J)
description: Declaration signed by both spouses with a joint photograph, in the Passport Seva Annexure J format.

name: Aadhaar showing updated name
description: Aadhaar letter/card/e-Aadhaar after a name update.

name: Passport showing updated name
description: Passport reissued with the changed name/surname.

name: PAN card / e-PAN
description: Permanent Account Number allotted by the Income Tax Department.

name: Birth certificate (Registration of Births and Deaths Act)
name_hi: जन्म प्रमाणपत्र (जन्म और मृत्यु पंजीकरण अधिनियम)
description: Birth certificate issued under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969.

name: Matriculation (Class 10) certificate
description: Matriculation certificate showing date of birth.

name: Matriculation marksheet (recognised board)
description: Matriculation marksheet issued by a recognised board.

name: CGHS card
description: Central Government Health Scheme card.

name: DigiLocker account access
description: Access to the DigiLocker platform (used to fetch proof of date of birth).

name: Separate affidavits of husband and wife (prescribed format)
name_hi: पति और पत्नी के अलग-अलग शपथपत्र (निर्धारित प्रारूप)
description: Affidavits stating date and place of marriage, date of birth, marital status, non-prohibited relationship and citizenship.

name: Attested passport-size and ceremonial photographs of both parties
name_hi: दोनों पक्षों के सत्यापित पासपोर्ट आकार व समारोह के फ़ोटो
description: Passport-size photographs (2 each) and ceremonial photographs, attested as specified.

name: Marriage invitation card
description: Self-attested wedding invitation card.

name: Divorce decree/order or death certificate of former spouse
name_hi: तलाक़ की डिक्री/आदेश या पूर्व जीवनसाथी का मृत्यु प्रमाणपत्र
description: Attested copy, for divorced or widowed applicants.

name: Certificate from the priest
description: Certificate from the priest who solemnised the marriage at a religious place.

name: Embassy certificate of present marital status
name_hi: वर्तमान वैवाहिक स्थिति का दूतावास प्रमाणपत्र
description: For a foreign national party.

name: Aadhaar number(s) of the parent(s) / legal guardian
name_hi: माता-पिता / कानूनी अभिभावक के आधार नंबर
description: Aadhaar numbers of both parents, or of the single parent/legal guardian the child lives with.

name: Document proving legal guardianship
description: Issued by a Central/State Government authority or a court under the relevant Acts.

name: Child's Aadhaar
description: Aadhaar issued after enrolment of a child.
